metadata.description: Delegation control plane for Claude Code: implementation goes to a GPT-5.6 Luna Codex lane by default and stays Claude-side for a named reason, each lane isolated in its own git worktree, with a model-parameterized Claude-side implementer and a Fable 5 reviewer used in proportion to risk.

plugins.name: fable-advisor
plugins.description: Implementation goes to the Codex lane by default and stays Claude-side only for one of five named reasons. Every lane runs in a disposable worktree, so a scope violation cannot destroy another lane's uncommitted work. Three lanes: Codex (GPT-5.6 Luna), a haiku/sonnet/fable implementer selected on the spawn, and a read-only Fable 5 reviewer.
